maintenance_led.reason: Revenue is rent from leasing office, lab and mixed-use properties it owns and develops, not repair or replacement work.

publicly_funded.reason: Tenants are private companies, universities and life-science firms paying office and lab rent; not mainly government-paid.

serial_acquirer.reason: Grows mainly by developing and leasing its own Philadelphia, DC and Austin properties, not a steady stream of acquisitions.

mission_critical.reason: Office tenants can relocate at lease end; space is largely substitutable, though lab build-outs raise switching costs somewhat.

notes: Mission-critical is a judgment call: lab build-outs raise switching costs, but most revenue is standard office leasing.
